services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Experience the beauty of Loon Lake from the water with our boating adventures. Bring your own boat or rent one of ours and get the most out of enjoying the lake. Supported by our fuel station and General Store, we have everything you need to enjoy the shimmering waters of Loon Lake. Enjoy the tranquil waters by renting a boat. Boat rentals are only available during open hours and are on a first-come-first-serve basis. Boats can be reserved upon reservation. Capacity: Varies on size of boat Availability: 4 pontoon boats; two 14′ aluminum boats with seatsPricing: 16′ $150/day or $90/half day; 18′ $160/day or $95/half day; 24′ $170/day or $100/half day; Aluminum boat $90/day or $50/half day.
